Laurey 72966, 2 Inch T-Knob Cosmopolitan in Oil Rubbed Bronze

The Oil Rubbed Bronze Cosmopolitan T-Knob is modern and sleek. It is easy to install on any size kitchen cabinet door or drawer. The 2 Inch T-Knob Cosmopolitan in Oil Rubbed Bronze comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 72966 Cosmopolitan Oil Rubbed Bronze T-Knob:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length: 2"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.
